articles.title_en: Beliefs about inequality and the nature of support for redistribution
articles.title_cn: 关于不平等的信念与再分配支持的性质
articles.abstract_en: Do beliefs about inequality depend on distributive preferences? What is the joint role of preferences and beliefs about inequality for support for redistribution? We study these questions in a staggered experiment with a broadly representative sample of the Swiss population conducted in the context of a vote on a highly redistributive policy proposal. Our sample comprises a majority of inequality averse subjects, a sizeable group of altruistic subjects, and a minority of predominantly selfish subjects. Irrespective of preference types, individuals overestimate the extent of income inequality. An information intervention successfully corrects these large misperceptions for all types, but essentially does not affect aggregate support for redistribution. These results hide, however, important heterogeneity because the effects of beliefs about inequality for demand for redistribution are preference-dependent: only inequality averse individuals, but not the selfish and altruistic ones, significantly reduce their support for redistribution. These findings cast a new light on the seemingly puzzling result that, in the aggregate, large changes in beliefs about inequality often do not translate into changes in demand for redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于不平等的信念是否取决于分配偏好？关于不平等的偏好和信念对再分配支持的联合作用是什么？我们在瑞士人口的一个广泛代表性样本中，以交错实验的方式研究了这些问题，该实验是在一项高度再分配政策提案的投票背景下进行的。我们的样本包括大多数厌恶不平等的主体、相当数量的利他主体，以及少数以自私为主的主体。无论偏好类型如何，个体都高估了收入不平等的程度。一项信息干预成功纠正了所有类型的这些重大误解，但基本上不影响对再分配的总体支持。然而，这些结果隐藏了重要的异质性，因为关于不平等的信念对再分配需求的影响是依赖于偏好的：只有厌恶不平等的个体，而非自私和利他的个体，显著减少了他们对再分配的支持。这些发现为看似令人困惑的结果提供了新的视角，即在总体上，关于不平等的信念的大幅变化往往不会转化为再分配需求的变化。

articles.title_en: Avoidance Responses to the Wealth Tax
articles.abstract_en: As a consequence of the Great Recession, the Spanish government reintroduced the Wealth Tax in 2011. We exploit the variation in wealth tax exposure to analyse taxpayers’ responses to this reintroduction. While facing higher wealth taxes did not discourage savings, results indicate that a 0.1 percentage point increase in the average tax rate leads to a reduction in taxable wealth of 3.21% over 4 years. In particular, the reduction in taxable wealth comes from taking advantage of exemptions, mostly business-related. Thus, the reintroduction induced avoidance. Taxpayers also take advantage of the limit on tax liability through a change in their asset and income composition. By far, this latter source of avoidance accounts for the greatest impact on tax revenues (92.6%). The impact of these avoidance strategies on revenue collected was far from negligible, since according to our estimates they represent a 2012-2015 revenue loss of 2.75 times the 2011 estimated wealth tax revenues. These findings should be useful to policymakers and administrations considering the implementation of a wealth tax, as they illustrate the pitfalls to be circumvented.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为大衰退的后果，西班牙政府于2011年重新引入了财富税。我们利用财富税暴露的变化来分析纳税人对这一重新引入的反应。虽然面临更高的财富税并未抑制储蓄，但结果表明，平均税率每增加0.1个百分点，应税财富在4年内减少3.21%。特别是，应税财富的减少来自于利用豁免，主要是与商业相关的豁免。因此，重新引入引发了规避行为。纳税人还通过改变其资产和收入构成来利用税负上限。到目前为止，后一种规避来源对税收收入的影响最大（92.6%）。这些规避策略对征收收入的影响远非微不足道，因为根据我们的估计，它们代表了2012-2015年收入损失，相当于2011年估计财富税收入的2.75倍。这些发现对于考虑实施财富税的政策制定者和行政管理部门应该是有用的，因为它们说明了需要规避的陷阱。

articles.title_en: The employment effects of a pandemic wage subsidy
articles.title_cn: 大流行工资补贴对就业的影响
articles.abstract_en: We estimate causal effects of a pandemic-era wage subsidy in Canada on job losses and business closures. Our estimates use administrative microdata and a regression discontinuity strategy to estimate the effects of marginal changes in the wage subsidy rate. The estimated net wage elasticity of employment was 0.05 to 0.22, implying a small employment effect of the program and an estimated fiscal cost per job saved of more than $185,000 per year. Subsidy payments caused a small but persistent reduction in business closure rates during subsequent waves of the pandemic, and increased earnings of existing employees. In all, our results suggest the subsidies did little to preserve job matches, but played a greater role in the overall social insurance response to the pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计了加拿大大流行时期的工资补贴对失业和企业倒闭的因果影响。我们的估计使用行政微观数据和断点回归策略来估计工资补贴率边际变化的影响。估计的就业净工资弹性为 0.05 至 0.22，这意味着该计划对就业的影响较小，并且估计每年每个工作岗位节省的财政成本超过 $185,000。在随后的疫情浪潮中，补贴支付导致企业倒闭率小幅但持续下降，并增加了现有员工的收入。总而言之，我们的结果表明，补贴对维持就业匹配几乎没有什么作用，但在社会保险应对疫情的整体反应中发挥了更大的作用。

articles.title_en: Gulags, crime, and elite violence: Origins and consequences of the Russian mafia
articles.title_cn: 古拉格、犯罪与精英暴力：俄罗斯黑手党的起源与后果
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the origins and consequences of the Russian mafia (vory-v-zakone). Using a unique web scraped dataset containing detailed biographies of more than 5,000 mafia leaders, I first show that the Russian mafia originated in the Soviet Gulag, and could be found near the camps’ initial locations throughout the 1990s Russia. Then, using an instrumental variable approach that exploits the proximity of the Russian mafia to the camps, I show that Russian communities with mafia presence in the 1990s experienced a dramatic rise in crime driven by elite violence which erupted shortly after the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991. The surge in violence was indiscriminate with respect to the victim type. Furthermore, the effect of mafia presence on elite violence was smaller in places where either all or none of the vory were ethnic Russians, suggesting some degree of ethnic conflict within the criminal organization itself.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了俄罗斯黑手党（vory-v-zakone）的起源与后果。利用一个独特的网络抓取数据集，其中包含超过5,000名黑手党头目的详细传记，我首先表明俄罗斯黑手党起源于苏联古拉格，并且在1990年的俄罗斯，可以在劳改营最初位置附近找到其踪迹。然后，利用一种利用俄罗斯黑手党与劳改营邻近性的工具变量方法，我表明在1990年有黑手党存在的俄罗斯社区，在1991年苏联解体后不久爆发的精英暴力推动下，犯罪率急剧上升。暴力的激增对受害者类型不加区分。此外，在那些所有或没有vory成员是俄罗斯族的地方，黑手党存在对精英暴力的影响较小，这表明犯罪组织内部存在一定程度的种族冲突。

articles.title_en: Present bias in politics and self-committing treaties
articles.title_cn: 政治中的现时偏差与自我承诺条约
articles.abstract_en: We study how international environmental agreements can take advantage of domestic time-inconsistency problems. Policymakers often prefer future policies to be sustainable, but are tempted to invest less when being in office. We find the equilibrium number of signatory countries to be higher than when preferences are time consistent, especially when the political environment is unstable and polarized and the international spillovers are limited. This model also explains participation in treaties whose mandates do not vary with the coalition size and why the coalition will not unravel if, for example, the US exits the Paris Agreement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究国际环境协议如何利用国内时间不一致问题。政策制定者通常偏好未来的政策具有可持续性，但在任期内却倾向于减少投资。我们发现，当偏好时间一致时，签署国的均衡数量更高，尤其是在政治环境不稳定、两极分化以及国际溢出效应有限的情况下。该模型还解释了为何参与条约的授权不随联盟规模变化，以及为何联盟不会因例如美国退出《巴黎协定》而瓦解。

articles.title_en: The structure of online social networks and social movements: Evidence from the Black Lives Matter protests
articles.title_cn: 在线社交网络的结构与社会运动：来自“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents that online social networks – Facebook in particular – can facilitate the spread of social movements across space and time. Focusing on the largest protest movement in recent history, the wave of Black Lives Matter protests sparked by the killing of George Floyd on 25 May 2020, we show that protests are more likely to spill over between US counties when they are more closely connected within the Facebook network. To identify causal effects, we develop an instrumental variable approach that exploits local Facebook outages as a source of exogenous variation in the structure of the online network.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了在线社交网络——尤其是Facebook——可以促进社会运动在空间和时间上的传播。聚焦于近期历史上最大规模的抗议运动，即由乔治·弗洛伊德于2020年五月25日被杀引发的“黑人的命也是命”抗议浪潮，我们表明，当美国各县在Facebook网络中联系更紧密时，抗议活动更有可能在它们之间蔓延。为了识别因果效应，我们开发了一种工具变量方法，利用当地Facebook中断作为在线网络结构外生变化的来源。

articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the regulation of technological innovation direction under uncertainty about potential harms. We develop a model with two competing technological paths and analyse various regulatory interventions. The optimal regulatory approach depends critically on the magnitude of potential harm relative to technological benefits. Our analysis reveals a motive to double down on harmful technologies in resource allocation across research paths, challenging common intuitions about diversification. We demonstrate that ex post regulatory instruments, particularly liability regimes, outperform ex ante restrictions in many scenarios. These insights have important implications for regulating emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, suggesting the need for informationally-responsive regulatory frameworks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在潜在危害不确定的情况下对技术创新方向的规制。我们构建了一个包含两条竞争性技术路径的模型，并分析了各种规制干预措施。最优规制方法关键取决于潜在危害相对于技术收益的大小。我们的分析揭示了在跨研究路径的资源分配中，存在一种对有害技术加倍投入的动机，这挑战了关于多样化的常见直觉。我们证明，事后规制工具，特别是责任制度，在许多情境下优于事前限制。这些见解对规制人工智能等新兴技术具有重要意义，表明需要信息响应型规制框架。

articles.title_en: New evidence on the efficacy of state-based retirement programs: The case of OregonSaves
articles.title_cn: 州级退休计划有效性的新证据：俄勒冈储蓄计划案例
articles.abstract_en: Seventeen US states have mandated employers to facilitate auto-enrollment retirement saving for workers lacking access to employer-sponsored plans, and proposed federal legislation seeks to extend these plans to the national level. This paper examines the experience with OregonSaves, the country’s longest-running plan, documenting that the program did prompt some participant savings. Median account balances were about $600 by mid-2023, but opt-out rates were above 50%, especially for the low-paid. Repeated exposure to the plan slightly reduced opt-outs, though withdrawals remained common. While modest savings accrued for many, it remains unclear whether these accounts will grow large enough to significantly increase retirement consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国有十七个州已强制要求雇主为无法获得雇主赞助计划的工人提供自动注册退休储蓄，且拟议的联邦立法旨在将这些计划推广至全国层面。本文考察了俄勒冈储蓄计划（该国运行时间最长的计划）的经验，记录显示该计划确实促进了部分参与者的储蓄。截至2023年中期，账户余额中位数约为600美元，但退出率超过50%，尤其是低收入群体。反复接触该计划略微降低了退出率，尽管取款仍然普遍。虽然许多人积累了适度的储蓄，但这些账户是否会增长到足以显著增加退休消费仍不明朗。

articles.title_en: Social networks and organizational helping behavior: Experimental evidence from the helping game
articles.title_cn: 社会网络与组织帮助行为：来自帮助博弈的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the causal impact of social ties and network structure on helping behavior in organizations. We introduce and experimentally study a game called the ‘helping game,’ where individuals unilaterally decide whether to incur a cost to help other team members when helping is a rivalrous good. We find that social ties have a strong positive effect on helping behavior. Individuals are more likely to help those with whom they are connected, but the likelihood of helping decreases as the social distance between individuals increases. Additionally, individuals randomly assigned to be more central in the network are more likely to help others.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了社会联系和网络结构对组织中帮助行为的因果影响。我们引入并实验研究了一种称为“帮助博弈”的游戏，在该游戏中，当帮助是一种竞争性商品时，个体单方面决定是否承担成本去帮助其他团队成员。我们发现，社会联系对帮助行为有强烈的正向影响。个体更可能帮助与其有联系的人，但随着个体之间社会距离的增加，帮助的可能性会降低。此外，被随机分配在网络中更中心位置的个体更可能帮助他人。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal income taxation in an environment where matching frictions generate a trade-off for workers between high wages and low unemployment risk. A higher marginal tax rate shifts the trade-off in favor of low unemployment risk, whereas a higher tax burden or unemployment benefit has the opposite effect. Changes in unemployment generate fiscal externalities, which modify optimal tax formulas. A calibration exercise to the US economy suggests that optimal marginal tax rates and employment taxes are hardly affected if unemployment responses to taxation are taken into account.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在匹配摩擦导致工人面临高工资与低失业风险之间权衡的环境中，最优所得税的设计。较高的边际税率使权衡偏向于低失业风险，而较高的税收负担或失业救济金则产生相反的效果。失业的变化会产生财政外部性，从而修改最优税收公式。针对美国经济的校准实验表明，如果考虑失业对税收的反应，最优边际税率和就业税几乎不受影响。

articles.title_en: Two decades of top income shares in Honduras
articles.title_cn: 洪都拉斯顶层收入份额的二十年
articles.abstract_en: This study constructs distributional national accounts for Honduras from 2003 to 2019, integrating household surveys, administrative tax records, and national account aggregates. It assembles comprehensive data on formal income for high-income individuals, including information on corporate shareholders, which allows corporate profits to be assigned to their owners. Findings reveal a high and persistent inequality: the top 1 percent highest earners received approximately 30 percent of total pre-tax income, placing Honduras among the most unequal countries in the world. Capital income, mostly undistributed corporate profits, represent close to half of income for the top 0.1% of earners, highlighting its role in driving top income dynamics. Finally, using a panel of tax records, we also document that not only inequality is mostly unchanged over two decades, but the identity of top earners is also persistent — over half of those observed in the top 0.1% will stay there in a three year horizon.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究构建了洪都拉斯从2003年到2019年的分配国民账户，整合了家庭调查、行政税务记录和国民账户总量。它汇集了高收入个体正式收入的全面数据，包括公司股东的信息，这使得企业利润能够归属于其所有者。研究结果显示，不平等程度高且持续存在：顶层1%的最高收入者获得了总税前收入的约30%，使洪都拉斯成为世界上最不平等的国家之一。资本收入，主要是未分配的企业利润，占顶层0.1%收入者收入的近一半，突显了其在推动顶层收入动态中的作用。最后，利用税务记录面板，我们还记录了不仅不平等在二十年间基本未变，而且顶层收入者的身份也具有持续性——在顶层0.1%中观察到的超过一半的人将在三年内保持在该位置。
